source_behavior.entry: CLogDlg::OnLvnColumnclick, when not filling arrays, schedules LOG_HEADER_ORDER_TIMER at 10 ms; timer opens modal CLogOrdering and Refresh only on IDOK. This applies to column click rather than independent in-memory column sorting.
source_behavior.preference: Software\TortoiseGit\LogOrderBy, default 1; load on initialize, persist selected item data only on OK, Cancel leaves prior preference and Log intact.
source_behavior.force_topology: CGit::GetLogCmd topo-order mask can override selected preference; preserve topology-required consumers such as Revision Graph independently.

current_native_evidence.HistoryOptions: No ordering field exists at this checkpoint.
current_native_evidence.Log_revision_table: Has header context menu for columns; no didClickTableColumn ordering-dialog callback.
current_native_evidence.dialog: No native ordering controller or source-like four-choice picker.

required_acceptance: Add persistent four-value history ordering using exact Git flags; chronological git-default is not --reverse.
Native compact dialog with label/combo/OK/Cancel, draft selection and correct Escape/Return, inherited appearance and private preferences.
Route actual Log header column click through owned controller; busy and child gates; OK reloads, Cancel preserves selection/data/preferences.
Real DAG with different author/committer dates and sibling topology; compare ordered hashes to direct Git for all four modes under system, old and packaged engines.
Selection restoration, pagination/filter/path/range and compact graph lanes must follow the chosen walk rather than independently sorting rows.
Physical layout, VoiceOver, signed sandbox and localization remain separate gates.
